Subject: Request: temporary extension to Net90 + credit buffer

Hi Rishi,

Hope you're well. We're consolidating AP across a newly-acquired EU subsidiary and will have a stretched cash cycle for Q3. Can ClearHarbor get a temporary extension to Net90 for invoices dated Aug–Sep (we expect to normalize in Oct)?

If an extended term is not possible, we'd like to propose a hybrid: Net60 with a 30% prepay on onboarding invoices and a short-term increase to our credit cap to cover burst usage.

We can supply a PO and VAT registration info quickly — just need to know what evidence Redwood needs and whether you can enable the requested terms for a 60–90 day pilot.

Thanks — appreciate any flexibility.

Best,
Elena Voss

Elena — thanks for the note and context. Quick thoughts:

- Net90 is outside our standard risk tolerance for first-quarter consolidation; we can consider a short trial but with tighter guardrails.
- Proposed compromise: temporary Net60 for Aug–Sep with a dynamic credit trigger. If monthly spend > agreed threshold, we shift to a 50% prepay for that month and put billing on Net30 until balance is reduced.
- We can offer a one-off credit buffer increase to $75k during the 60-day pilot, subject to a holdback mechanism (more below).

What we need from you to move quickly:
1) Signed PO for initial month (attach).
2) VAT registration certificate for your billing entity (EU VAT reverse-charge specifics differ by country).
3) Confirmation of your preferred contact at AP for remittance and ACH details (if available).

I'll loop in Finance (kimberly) to document the controls and propose exact language for the amendment. Attached: draft SOW (SOW_Redwood_ClearHarbor_v3.pdf) for reference.

If that sounds workable I can circulate a short amendment and a DocuSign link today.

—Rishi

Subject: Re: Request: temporary extension to Net90 + credit buffer — finance controls and amendment language

Hi all — looping in Finance to formalize the pilot. Proposed amendment terms below (suggested legal & finance language):

1) Trial window: 2026-08-01 through 2026-09-30 — invoices issued during the window to be Net60 from invoice date.
2) Credit buffer: Redwood to increase credit cap to USD 75,000 for the trial period.
3) Dynamic trigger: if rolling 30-day invoice volume > USD 60,000, then for the following billing cycle: (a) charge 50% upfront for that cycle; (b) subsequent invoices revert to Net30 until outstanding balance < USD 30,000.
4) Holdback: 15% retainage on monthly invoices during the trial, released 45 days after invoice date upon receipt of VAT evidence and no active disputes. ClearHarbor requested max 20% — we can agree 15% for speed.
5) Documentation: ClearHarbor to provide VAT certificate and signed PO prior to first invoice; Redwood to provide monthly statement and ledger extracts.
6) Termination: Either party may terminate trial with 30 days notice; outstanding balances due per amendment.

Action items:
- Rishi: confirm wording and send DocuSign amendment.
- Elena: confirm acceptance of 15% retainage and dynamic trigger thresholds.
- PrIyom: confirm we can authorize the $75k temporary credit increase (I believe commercial approved).

I'll prepare the amendment and include DocuSign link in the next message.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Sr. Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
